entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Surp Marineh Church was one of eight churches existing in town of Moush before the Armenian genocide. Surp Marineh was the most notable church in whole Tarawn region of Historical Armenia, and was known as "Katoghike". Currently it is in a ruinous state and only parts of the outer walls still stand.
